predicates.description: The taxable income of a married individual filing a separate return.
predicates.supporting_span: the taxable income of every married individual (as defined in section 7703) who does not make a single return jointly with his spouse

predicates.description: The tax amount determined for a married individual filing a separate return.
predicates.supporting_span: a tax determined in accordance with the following

rules.supporting_span: (i) 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $18,450;
rules.explanation: A tax of 15% is applied to the taxable income of a married individual if it does not exceed $18,450.

rules.supporting_span: (ii) $2,767.50, plus 28% of the excess over $18,450 if the taxable income is over $18,450 but not over $44,575;
rules.explanation: A tax of $2,767.50 plus 28% of the amount exceeding $18,450 is applied if the taxable income is between $18,450 and $44,575.

rules.supporting_span: (iii) $10,082.50, plus 31% of the excess over $44,575 if the taxable income is over $44,575 but not over $70,000;
rules.explanation: A tax of $10,082.50 plus 31% of the amount exceeding $44,575 is applied if the taxable income is between $44,575 and $70,000.

rules.supporting_span: (iv) $17,964.25, plus 36% of the excess over $70,000 if the taxable income is over $70,000 but not over $125,000;
rules.explanation: A tax of $17,964.25 plus 36% of the amount exceeding $70,000 is applied if the taxable income is between $70,000 and $125,000.

rules.supporting_span: (v) $37,764.25, plus 39.6% of the excess over $125,000 if the taxable income is over $125,000
rules.explanation: A tax of $37,764.25 plus 39.6% of the amount exceeding $125000 is applied if the taxable income exceeds $125,000.
